native_result.query: What is the average length of original papers in Experimental Economics and that in Psychology?
native_result.HypoA: Studies in Experimental Economics tend to have longer original papers compared to Psychology. The average length of original papers in Experimental Economics is 28 pages, whereas in Psychology, the average is 11 pages.
native_result.HypoB: Original research papers in Experimental Economics are substantially longer than original papers in Psychology: the average length of papers in Experimental Economics is 28.00 pages, compared to an average length of 11.07 to 11.22 pages in Psychology (11.22 in the Reproducibility Project: Psychology, and 11.07 across social and cognitive psychology studies).
native_result.WorkflowB: 1. Загрузка данных из meta-regression_study_data_heterogeneity_in_replication_projects.csv. 2. Дедупликация до уровня оригинальных исследований по id и title. 3. Расчет mean, median, std, min, max для Experimental Economics и Psychology (в двух срезах: проект RPP и дисциплины Social+Cognitive). 4. Проверка устойчивости на сырых строках и статистическое тестирование (t-тест Уэлча и тест Манна-Уитни).
